ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: If man died out, what would most likely happen to the chicken population?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food-web image labels several organisms: man at the top, birds at the upper right, duck at the left, chicken in the center, beetle on the right, corn at lower left, worm in the center, guava at lower right, pechay below worm, and bacteria/fungi at the bottom. There is a direct arrow/link from man to chicken, showing that man directly consumes or reduces chickens in this diagram. Reasoning: The question asks what would happen to the chicken population if man died out. In a food web, if a predator or consumer is removed, the population of the organism it eats or suppresses usually increases. Since man directly affects chickens, removing man would let the chicken population rise.
